## p2pchat v0.5.0

This release makes p2pchat publicly installable from npm and adds isolated
local profiles plus Pi-style slash-command autocomplete.

### Highlights

- Install the `p2pchat` CLI from the public npm registry.
- Create independent local users with `p2pchat --profile <name>`.
- Protect every profile with its own password and database containing encrypted
  messages, private identities, ratchet state, and trusted peer state.
- Type `/` for fuzzy command completion and keyboard navigation.
- Exit reliably with `/quit` or `/exit` across terminal Enter encodings.
- Connect over the production Cloudflare relay while retaining Signal PQXDH and
  Double Ratchet end-to-end encryption.

### Install

```sh
corepack pnpm add --global \
  --allow-build=better-sqlite3 \
  --allow-build=@signalapp/libsignal-client \
  @ashrithsathu/p2pchat

p2pchat --profile alice
```

### Security status

The client has strict automated protocol, persistence, tamper, replay, direct
network, and deployed-relay tests. It has not received an independent security
audit. Review `SECURITY.md` before relying on it for sensitive use.
